_note: The FLWO 60-inch (Tillinghast) TCSGO server: Alpaca telescope/0 and focuser/0 over the DFM TCSGalil.
tcs.host is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder (a simulator: python -m robofast.devices.tcsgo_sim --port 5003).
Real hardware needs allow_hardware: true here AND --hardware on the command line; see docs/tcsgo.md first.
dome: false until it is confirmed that the 60-inch dome is wired to the TCS (docs/tcsgo.md, questions).
guide_rate 2.0 arcsec/s is what the legacy TCS window sets (#15) at startup; robofast never sends #15, so this only describes the TCS.
park_command zenith = the legacy 60-inch stow (#10 + #12,2, then hold #12,0); the legacy software never sends #58. dome_park_az 235 = the legacy dome stow, used only with dome: true.
Offsets never use #7 (broken per the live TRES guider): #6 + chase #12,3, then follow #12,1 and the old target restored (docs/tcsgo.md Q8).
focus_min/focus_max and min_interval are unconfirmed for the 60-inch (the guider's focus sweeps stay within +-1000 um).
name, latitude, longitude, elevation, min_alt, park_*, guide_rate, aperture_diameter (m; the 60-inch's 1.524) and, with the focuser, focus_min/focus_max are required: the server has no site defaults.
name: flwo60
